issues.on_page: Grants 23,716.36 (General Fund; Statement of Activities p5 lists Grants separately from State Receipts 50,721.33)
issues.issue: No grantor is printed, and the report itself doesn't count the line as state receipts. Under the FY2022/FY2023 ruling (2026-11-12), grant lines with no grantor printed are category other, detail_category Grants. Same for detail[12] (p9, detail_category 'other state aid').

Schedule p11 shows the whole amount is Community Center 1,784.97 + RV Park 4,464.00, both culture/recreation, so the label could be 'Capital Outlay: Culture/Recreation'. The Equipment line 9,637.89 (disbursements[15]) is mixed (General 3,637.89, RV Park 3,000, Street 3,000), so plain 'Capital outlay' fits there.

Spending is listed by object only. This line is mostly Street Fund (74%) but is tagged general government. The extractor's own review note says 'mostly Street Fund', and its rules say to use the dominant function, which would be streets/highways.
